title: Database out of memory
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies DB as broken part, memory OOM problem, and API 2.4.0 query as trigger.
option_titles: Increase DB memory limit to accommodate the query
root_cause: The new api version 2.4.0 executes a heavy multi‑join query that consumes nearly all of the PostgreSQL container’s memory, triggering the Linux OOM killer and crashing the DB.
truth: api 2.4.0 added a sales report query that makes PostgreSQL use more than its 1 GB memory limit, so it is killed (out of memory, signal 9) and keeps restarting.
